purpose: Ensure all M3 model frameworks consume the same deterministic selected-pool training-example sequence instead of only sharing the same episode pool.

policy.name: uniform_selected_frames_with_replacement_v1
policy.mapping_rule: map the global selected-frame position into the manifest-ordered episode list using exact episode lengths from LeRobot meta/episodes parquet

equal_wall.stream_rule: consume the same deterministic counter stream from sample_index=0 until the runner stops at the first safe optimizer boundary at or after 1800 train-loop seconds
equal_wall.comparison_note: Models may consume different prefix lengths because throughput differs, but every model sees the same ordered stream prefix for a given seed.

forward_reverse_rule: Forward and reverse execution orders must reuse the same schedule algorithm, D10 hash, and seed-specific schedule SHA/reference stream. Execution order must never perturb sample generation.
